title: Implement PostureDashboard.tsx — full 3ft compliance view from V1 mockup

round_details.llm_summary: Implemented full PostureDashboard.tsx replacing stub with a complete 3-row compliance dashboard: hero posture score + 8 D3-computed donut rings, NIST family stacked bars with family flyout, gap analysis stats, drift alerts list, and top risk controls table. Added EmbryStyle token-based styling, accessibility titles/focus outlines/no color-only signaling, required data-qid/data-qs-action attributes on all interactive elements, and comprehensive useRegisterAction registrations for dashboard and interaction action classes.
